summary.text: Chris Conroy is the Democratic candidate for the New Hampshire House of Representatives, Hillsborough 44, in the November 3, 2026 general election.
A small business owner who ran a video production company, he said in a Ballotpedia survey that his priorities include affordability, civility in government, local control and the environment.

paragraphs.text: In a Ballotpedia survey, Chris Conroy said he and his wife moved to New Hampshire 36 years ago, lived in Goffstown for 12 years, and have lived in Weare for nearly 21 years.
He said he started a video production company, Heartwood Media, which he ran for close to 30 years, working with nonprofits, state agencies and corporations.
He said he has served on boards including the Piscataquog Land Conservancy, Businesses for Social Responsibility and the NH Center for Nonprofits, and is vice chair of the Weare Energy Commission.

He listed three campaign messages: government that works for everyone, including relief from high property taxes rather than tax cuts for large businesses; bringing civility back to government; and protecting local control against laws that override town meeting votes.
